text: Ivette Otazu Olarte most chances that the translation in your country will not be enough - even to Hebrew there is a chance they will not accept ( from my experience I was lucky to find a notary translation to Hebrew , even though it has apostille on both - and it was not accepted in Israel and I had to translate it again here) so to save you the cost don’t bother to translate it anywhere else but in Israel by a notary who speaks both languages).
